_comment: Copy this file to api_keys.json and fill in your own keys. api_keys.json is git-ignored.
_instructions: Every key is OPTIONAL. Missing keys are skipped gracefully — the search degrades rather than fails. Any value here can also be supplied via environment variable (see README), which takes precedence.

openalex._note: Free, no key required. Adding `mailto` joins the faster polite pool. Docs: https://developers.openalex.org/

core._note: Free with key (100 req/min). Register: https://core.ac.uk/services/api/#form

scopus._note: Requires institutional access. Free tier 5,000 calls/week: https://dev.elsevier.com/

semantic_scholar._note: Works without a key at a lower rate limit. Keyed access is 1 request/second, cumulative across all endpoints. Request one: https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api

unpaywall._note: No key needed, but an email is a REQUIRED parameter. Layer 6 OA lookup is skipped when this is empty.

crossref._note: Free. Adding an email joins the polite pool (50 req/5min).

arxiv._note: No key required. Free and unlimited via http://export.arxiv.org/api/query

zenodo._note: Optional — works without a token. Create one: https://zenodo.org/account/settings/applications/

doaj._note: Optional — free without a key (100 req/min). Apply: https://doaj.org/apply-for-api-key/
